system.docHtml: The caster places both hands upon a wounded creature and channels a pulse of restorative Physéra energy into a single designated injury, triggering an immediate Healing Roll (with a +10 bonus on Critical Success). Untreated injuries continue to heal at a rate equivalent to a Critical Failure Treatment Roll. A Renew can only be cast once on any given injury, and only successes take effect; Healing Roll failures are ignored.
